title: Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Senior Azure Cloud Solution Architect

Location: Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Long term contract

Job Summary

We are seeking a visionary Automation Senior Cloud Solution Architect to lead the technical design and implementation of this transformative capability. This role is pivotal in architecting a scalable, AI-driven solution that seamlessly integrates advanced data processing, intuitive web interfaces, and intelligent automation.

This position demands a strategic leader who thrives in complexity and is deeply committed to cultivating strong stakeholder relationships. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, guiding cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that drive pricing transparency, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role with interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber/Privacy/Legal teams.

Key Responsibilities:

• Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.

• Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.

• End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.

• API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).

• ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.

• Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Key Qualifications and Experiences:

Technical Expertise:

• Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.

• Embedded Systems and CI/CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.

• Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP/REST) and API development.

• .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.

• Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.

• Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.

• Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.

• Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.

• Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.

Specialized Skills:

• Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.

• Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.

• Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.

Soft Skills and Others:

• Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.

• Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

Sobre a Vox Capital

Somos a gestora pioneira em investimento de impacto desde 2009 e uma das maiores gestoras da América latina, com R$1,4 bilhão de ativos sob gestão. Nosso foco está em investir em empresas de alto crescimento que, por meio da tecnologia, abordam os principais desafios da sociedade e do planeta. Atuamos em setores como saúde, educação, inclusão financeira, nutrição sustentável e transição climática, entre outros que integram nossa tese de investimentos de impacto socioambiental.

Trabalhando conosco, você vivenciará nossos valores em ação: a Vontade de gerar mudanças, criar soluções e crescer tanto pessoal quanto profissionalmente; o Vínculo com o propósito, com a empresa e com outras organizações de impacto; a Verdade consigo mesmo, com os colegas e com o mercado; a Vanguarda em produtos, impacto e atuação no mercado; e a Vibração pelo trabalho com propósito, pelas conquistas e pelos avanços.

Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão

A VOX Capital está em busca de novos talentos para integrar nossa equipe e contribuir para nossa missão de gerar impacto positivo. Valorizamos a diversidade e a inclusão em nosso ambiente de trabalho, por isso, incentivamos fortemente candidaturas de mulheres e pessoas negras, que terão prioridade no processo seletivo desta posição . Nosso compromisso é criar um espaço mais inclusivo e representativo, e buscamos pessoas que compartilhem desse propósito. Se você acredita no poder da diversidade e quer fazer parte de um time que atua para transformar a sociedade, queremos conhecer você!

title: Remote Senior Python Developer
description:

title: Agente de Vendas e Atendimento Membership
description:
MAIS QUE MERCADO

Somos parte de um dos maiores grupos varejistas do mundo, sendo o maior varejista do Brasil e um dos maiores empregadores privado do país, com mais de 130 mil pessoas colaboradoras, unidos no propósito de contribuir para uma alimentação mais acessível e de qualidade aos brasileiros e brasileiras.

Manifesto

No Grupo Carrefour Brasil, acreditamos que a verdadeira inclusão começa com a valorização das diferenças e a criação de um ambiente onde cada pessoa pode ser autêntica e alcançar seu pleno

potencial. Aqui, cada colaborador é respeitado e incentivado a trazer sua individualidade para o trabalho.

Nossa diversidade é a força que impulsiona nosso crescimento coletivo, criando um espaço de colaboração onde todos têm a oportunidade de prosperar.

O desenvolvimento profissional é parte essencial do que oferecemos. Acreditamos que o crescimento é uma jornada contínua, e por isso fornecemos as ferramentas e oportunidades necessárias para que cada colaborador possa expandir suas habilidades e evoluir dentro da empresa. Seja por meio da escola de líderes, programas afirmativos ou vagas internas, garantimos que todos possam avançar em seu próprio ritmo, construindo uma trajetória de sucesso dentro do Grupo.

A ascensão social faz parte do nosso compromisso em transformar vidas. Valorizamos o esforço e a dedicação, oferecendo caminhos claros para o crescimento. Muitos de nossos colaboradores que iniciaram suas carreiras em posições operacionais, como estoquistas ou operadores de caixa, têm a oportunidade de, por meio de nosso apoio e desenvolvimento contínuo, alcançar cargos de supervisão, gerência e até CEO.

No Grupo Carrefour Brasil, acreditamos que o sucesso não tem limites e todos podem crescer com

dedicação e apoio. Inclusão, desenvolvimento e ascensão social caminham JUNTOS.

Aqui, você pode ser você mesmo, evoluir como profissional e transformar a sua vida e a de sua família.

Venha fazer parte dessa história!

DO DISCURSO À PRÁTICA

Desafios dessa posição: Agente de Vendas e Atendimento Membership

  • Dar apoio ao atendimento aos clientes no Clube;
  • Será responsável pelas demandas administrativas no balcão de atendimento da loja;

  • Controlar relatórios em Excel.

Você precisa ter:

  • Experiência em vendas;
  • Pacote Office;
  • Ensino médio completo.

Adoraríamos se você tiver:

  • Senso de propriedade e responsabilidade;
  • Capacidade analítica;
  • Foco, dinamismo e disposição;
  • Organização, planejamento e disciplina.

VOCÊ MERECE O MELHOR

  • PAC - Programa de Apoio ao Colaborador: Atendimento profissional emergencial gratuito, sendo: psicológico, social, orientações financeiras e jurídica;
  • Avatar da Saúde - Com dicas de Saúde e qualidade de vida customizadas.

No Carrefour, trabalhamos diariamente a cultura do respeito e da equidade. A valorização da diversidade é um compromisso para o Carrefour, por isso, encorajamos a candidatura e damos oportunidade a profissionais diversos, sejam Mulheres, Negros (as), Pessoas LGBTI+, Pessoas com deficiência ou Pessoas em situação de refúgio.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (React/Golang)
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply. Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.

About the Role

We’re looking for a driven, resourceful, and experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join one of our growing product teams. As a senior member of the team, you will be tasked with designing, building, and enhancing services and user-facing features across our platform, with a strong focus on reliability, maintainability, scalability, and user experience. You’ll leverage your expertise spanning the entire stack, from database interactions to front-end libraries, contributing significantly to our technical direction and mentoring other engineers.

How you will make an impact

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable full-stack applications and features across a modern tech stack, including Typescript, React, Go and Postgres.
  • Focus on improving our user experience, collaborating with designers to implement intuitive interfaces and finding creative ways to reduce user pain points.
  • Build and enhance microservices, focusing on reliability, maintainability, and scalability within our distributed systems.
  • Ensure the quality of our products remains high by contributing to automated testing strategies and participating actively in code reviews.
  • Collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, QA analysts, and other engineers within an Agile development framework.
  • Contribute to engineering best practices, identifying and driving improvements in our processes, architecture, and technology stack.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a collaborative environment and sharing your expertise.
  • Distill user stories or business requirements into technical requirements and robust technical designs.

You may be a good fit for this role if you

  • Are passionate about coding and creating scalable systems and fantastic user experiences.
  • Embrace a growth mindset by continuously questioning established ideas and learning from your experiences.
  • Exhibit humility and a collaborative spirit, fostering a positive work environment while valuing the contributions of others without ego.
  • Value autonomy and empowerment to make your own decisions.

What you will do

During the 1st Month:

  • Attend onboarding sessions to better understand our internal processes and learn about the company
  • Pair with other engineers to learn more about our tech stack, the products we support, and our development standards and processes
  • Familiarize yourself with our automated testing platforms and begin to contribute to our test coverage
  • Collaborate with product team members to implement and ship small features and functionality

Within 3 Months:

  • Participate in code reviews and provide thoughtful, constructive feedback to other engineers
  • Gain exposure to the platform’s underlying infrastructure and deployment processes
  • Understand the high-level architecture of the website and back-end services
  • Begin shipping more complex user-facing code

Within 6 Months:

  • Grow as a contributing member of a product team, providing input and insight to the rest of the team on challenges and feasibility of proposed development
  • Confidently implement new functionality and fix bugs across our stack
  • Work with members of the tech and product teams to distill user stories or business requirements into technical requirements/design

Within 12 months:

  • Begin identifying areas for improvement in our codebase, researching best practices, and making recommendations to the team on strategies to address them
  • Solidify understanding of the breadth of our tech stack, including underlying infrastructure, internal tools, front end applications, and how they interact with our back-end services
  • Be a subject matter expert for the product team’s areas of responsibility

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Experience with Typescript and React
  • Experience with one or more general-purpose programming languages (Go, C/C++, C#, Java, Ruby, etc.)
  • Experience with one or more SQL databases
  • Strong understanding of common data structures and design patterns
  • Experience working with a microservice architecture and distributed systems
  • Proficiency in using unit testing frameworks
  • A dedication to developing clear, reliable, and maintainable code
  • Proficiency with common git operations
  • Strong communication skills, effectively conveying ideas to both technical and non-technical partners
  • Experience mentoring other engineers

title: PLM Windchill Developer
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced PLM Solution Specialist with strong expertise in PTC Windchill and ideally Dassault Systèmes 3DExperience (3DX) to support and optimize enterprise Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) initiatives. The role requires a blend of technical configuration, business process leadership, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver scalable PLM solutions aligned with business objectives.

Ideally, we would like to find professionals with knowledge and experience in both Windchill and 3DX . However, if one candidate is strong in Windchill and another is focused on 3DX, we will also consider this combination.

Key Responsibilities

PLM Systems Configuration & Support

  • Customize and configure Windchill and/or 3DX to meet company-specific requirements.
  • Build, update, and manage product data structures to support design and engineering teams.
  • Set up and improve change management processes (change requests, notices, approvals).
  • Configure and automate approval workflows for efficiency and compliance.
  • Modify and support lifecycle steps (draft, concept, design, released) to match internal business processes.
  • Integrate Windchill with SAP and other enterprise applications for design data management.
  • Suggest improvements for product data/document release processes, managing changes via JIRA.
  • Support system upgrades, testing, and technical improvements across global teams.

Business & Functional Leadership

  • Lead business and functional resources in the design of efficient enterprise business processes that leverage PLM solutions.
  • Facilitate workshops and working sessions to gather requirements, demonstrate software functions, or resolve issues.
  • Provide PLM application expertise to stakeholders for roadmap planning and technology evaluation.
  • Collaborate with the PLM Support team to ensure alignment on solution direction and strategy.
  • Provide high-level solution guidance and act as a change agent to drive adoption.
  • Perform cost-benefit analysis, define metrics, and track progress toward business objectives.
  • Develop standards, processes, procedures, and training materials to support PLM usage and adoption.
  • Analyze and revise existing systems and documentation to identify remediation or improvements.

Stakeholder & Relationship Management

  • Act as a trusted advisor with strong customer interfacing skills to communicate solution approaches.
  • Build and maintain relationships across business units, vendors, and technical teams.
  • Influence stakeholders, build support for PLM initiatives, and manage constructive tension when needed.
  • Lead design-related workshops, drive issue resolution, and ensure alignment across functions.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 5+ years’ experience in PLM products, including at least 3 years in PTC Windchill and 2 years in Dassault Systèmes 3DExperience .
  • 6+ years of system analysis and design experience , including enterprise-level application solutions (multi-tier, client/server, database, or web-based).
  • Experience with full software development lifecycle (SDLC) and formal project management methodologies.
  • Functional expertise in PLM applications ; technical domain knowledge is a plus.
  • Experience with Windchill 13 preferred.
  • Knowledge of BOM Views, MPMLink, Variant Configuration, Options and Variants highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with other PTC tools (Creo Parametric, Creo View, Integrity, ThingWorx) beneficial.
  • Experience extending the digital thread upstream/downstream from PLM an advantage.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into functional specifications.
  • Willingness to learn, recommend, and apply new technologies.

title: Strategic Operations Analyst
description:
Job Title: Strategic Operations Analyst

Department: Strategic Solutions

Employment Type: Full-Time

Level: Associate / Analyst

About the Role

We are looking for a Strategic Operations Analyst to join our Strategic Solutions Department. This role is pivotal in driving internal efficiency, enhancing CRM/PRM adoption, ensuring data integrity, and fostering cross-departmental collaboration. You will sit at the intersection of strategy, sales, and technology—acting both as a systems thinker and strategic enabler.

A key focus of this role is acting as a CRM/PRM & Sales Process Specialist, driving adoption and aligning business processes around our CRM/PRM platform (GAIA). You will serve as the internal champion of GAIA, ensuring that the system is a catalyst for sales excellence, better data quality, and smarter decision-making.

If you're analytical, process-oriented, and passionate about enabling teams through systems and data, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities:

Process Mapping & CRM/PRM Optimization

  • Map and refine GAIA (CRM/PRM) workflows to match real business needs
  • Standardize data fields, pipeline stages, and input protocols
  • Ensure the system supports sales and strategic workflows rather than complicates them
  • Act as liaison between Strategy, Sales, and IT/GAIA Team to align platform functionality with business goals

CRM/PRM Adoption & Change Enablement

  • Drive CRM/PRM adoption across sales and strategy teams
  • Embed best practices into daily commercial activities and routines
  • Monitor user behavior, provide coaching, and remove adoption blockers
  • Promote a culture of collaboration and continuous learning during system changes

Data Quality & Automation

  • Ensure data integrity through training, dashboards, and cleanup initiatives
  • Follow up with users and stakeholders to close data gaps
  • Identify and address inconsistencies in data entry
  • Collaborate on automation opportunities to reduce low-value administrative work
  1. Reporting & Insights Generation •
  • Structure CRM/PRM data for internal and external reporting
  • Extract insights from CRM data to support decision-making and strategic initiatives
  • Contribute to recurring and ad-hoc reports, dashboards, and presentations
  • Maintain internal documentation (SOPs, process logs, and insight trackers)

Strategic Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Support leadership with client segmentation, performance reviews, and market analysis
  • Map and document cross-departmental workflows to identify silos and inefficiencies
  • Recommend improvements to drive clarity, collaboration, and alignment
  • Participate in leadership and strategy meetings to influence prioritization and roadmap

What Success Looks Like

You won’t just help people use a CRM/PRM—you’ll transform how teams collaborate, improve the quality of decision-making, and foster a culture of excellence in managing clients, data, and processes. Success in this role means being able to first understand and optimize systems, then drive adoption across teams, ensure data quality, and ultimately support strategic goals through clear insights and structured reporting.

KPIs for Success

  • CRM/PRM adoption rate • % of deals with full, accurate data
  • Internal CRM/PRM satisfaction score
  • Frequency of data updates and system engagement
  • Reduction in manual reporting and redundant tools

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or related field
  • 1–3 years of experience in business analysis, sales operations, or internal consulting
  • Proven experience with CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, Dynamics)
  • Strong knowledge of sales processes and commercial workflows
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Experience with change management and user onboarding
  • Analytical mindset and strong critical thinking
  • Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; BI tools are a plus
  • Fluent in English (Norwegian is a plus)

Vaga afirmativa para mulheres.

A Aperam South América, líder em inovação e sustentabilidade, está em busca de uma pessoa Analista Tributária Especializada para integrar nossa equipe.

Desde 2011, a Aperam South América integra o Grupo Aperam, segundo maior da Europa, composto de outras cinco plantas industriais na França e na Bélgica, cuja capacidade alcança 2,5 milhões de toneladas de aço por ano.

No Brasil, a usina de Timóteo utiliza 100% de energia renovável graças à sua unidade no Vale do Jequitinhonha: a Aperam BioEnergia, que produz e comercializa carvão vegetal, tecnologia, mudas e sementes, a partir de florestas renováveis de eucalipto.

Com um modelo sustentável único em seu segmento, a Aperam South América é carbono neutro nos escopos 1 e 2 desde 2020, além de ser uma das poucas siderúrgicas brasileiras certificadas com o selo ResponsibleSteel.

Se você é apaixonada por sustentabilidade e quer fazer parte de uma transformação positiva no setor de aços inoxidáveis e elétricos, esta é sua oportunidade!

Por que escolher a Aperam?

Somos um lugar incrível para trabalhar! No segmento de Siderurgia e Mineração, conquistamos o 2º lugar no Prêmio “Lugares Incríveis para Trabalhar” , posição que mantemos há cinco anos. Esse reconhecimento reflete o nível de satisfação de nossas pessoas colaboradoras e nossa excelência em gestão de pessoas, clima organizacional e liderança.

Acreditamos que a diversidade fortalece nossa equipe e que a inclusão é essencial para um ambiente mais inovador e colaborativo. Buscamos pessoas que queiram crescer em um time que valoriza diferentes perspectivas e experiências.

Se você é uma pessoa apaixonada por sustentabilidade e quer fazer parte de uma transformação positiva no setor de aços inoxidáveis e elétricos, esta é sua oportunidade!

O que buscamos?

Assegurar a execução de processos tributários de altíssima complexidade.

Suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Atuar no compliance e planejamento tributário, com foco em tributos indiretos.
  • Garantir a conformidade das rotinas fiscais relacionadas a tributos indiretos, prestando suporte técnico à equipe e também contribuindo nas atividades de apuração, fechamento contábil, entrega de obrigações acessórias, contabilizações e conciliações, validações sistêmicas, além de apoiar no atendimento a fiscalizações e auditorias.
  • Acompanhar e avaliar as operações e atividades da Aperam, identificando oportunidades tributárias para o negócio e propondo medidas de mitigação de riscos.
  • Prestar suporte consultivo às áreas de negócio, avaliando operações e projetos sob a perspectiva tributária.
  • Apoiar a área Jurídica em contencioso tributário, fornecendo subsídios técnicos, cálculos e análises para defesa em processos administrativos e judiciais.
  • Assumir papel de referência técnica em tributos indiretos, liderando discussões e contribuindo para decisões na área financeira.
  • Conduzir projetos estratégicos da área, bem como de otimização de rotinas fiscais, incluindo atualizações tributárias ou sistêmicas de alto impacto para o departamento.
  • Manter-se atualizado em relação às alterações da legislação tributária, com atenção especial à Reforma Tributária, avaliando impactos e propondo adaptações necessárias.

O perfil que estamos buscando para essa posição:

  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis e/ou Direito.
  • Inglês avançado, com capacidade de leitura, escrita e conversação em ambiente corporativo.
  • Experiência mínima de 7 anos na área tributária, com atuação relevante em tributos indiretos.
  • Vivência em ambiente industrial será considerada um diferencial, bem como experiência em indústria florestal.
  • Conhecimento em ERP e soluções fiscais, sendo o SAP um diferencial.
  • Especialização em Finanças ou Planejamento Tributário será considerada um diferencial.
  • Perfil analítico, com visão de negócio, capacidade de identificar oportunidades e mitigar riscos.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para atuar de forma consultiva junto a diferentes áreas da companhia.

Benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Retorno de férias;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (Remuneração variável);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Assistência médica e odontológica;

  • Material escolar para filhos em idade escolar;
  • Parceria com academias (WellHub);
  • Auxílio-creche;
  • Licença-paternidade e maternidade estendida.

Nosso processo de seleção

Nosso processo de seleção, de forma geral, é constituído das seguintes etapas: inscrição e análise dos perfis com avaliação de currículos, entrevistas, avaliações comportamentais de inglês e exames admissionais.

title: SDR Bilíngue (Sales Development Representative)
description:
Descrição

Buscamos um SDR Bilíngue (Sales Development Representative) dinâmico, proativo e especialista em prospecção B2B para integrar nosso time, focado no mercado dos Estados Unidos. Este profissional será a força motriz por trás da expansão do nosso projeto SaaS . 

Atividades e Responsabilidades:

  • Configurar e otimizar campanhas de prospecção e conexão com leads dentro do nosso ICP (Ideal Customer Profile), utilizando ferramentas como LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Dux, etc.
  • Identificar dores, desafios e oportunidades dos leads que possam ser solucionados pela nossa empresa, para personalizar a abordagem de vendas.

  • Enviar mensagens personalizadas no LinkedIn e e-mails para leads qualificados, com o objetivo de gerar conexão, educar o mercado e despertar interesse no produto.
  • Realizar follow-ups constantes para nutrir o relacionamento com potenciais clientes, criando um cenário favorável para a conversão após a demonstração.
  • Manter o CRM (Hubspot) e outras planilhas internas meticulosamente atualizadas, registrando todas as interações e o progresso dos leads.
  • Gerir ativamente a agenda de demonstrações, incluindo marcação, confirmação e reagendamentos, atuando sempre com atenção e proatividade.
  • Colaborar com o time de vendas (Closers) para garantir que as reuniões agendadas sejam altamente produtivas, fornecendo todo o contexto necessário sobre o lead.

Requisitos:

  • Inglês fluente é importante e requisito , pois toda a comunicação (ligações, e-mails) será em inglês.
  • Cursando ou formado em Marketing, Administração, Comunicação ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência comprovada em prospecção e  cold calls .
  • Experiência prévia na qualificação de leads.
  • Experiência como SDR prospectando para produtos SaaS (Software as a Service) ou de tecnologia.
  • Boa capacidade de gerir múltiplas tarefas e cumprir prazos em um ambiente dinâmico.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita na língua portuguesa e inglesa.
  • Bons conhecimentos de informática, como MS Office, softwares de CRM (Hubspot é um diferencial), redes sociais e agendas eletrônicas.
  • Experiência e desenvoltura em reuniões remotas via Teams, Google Meet, etc.

Diferenciais:

  • Já ter atuado com segmentação e qualificação de leads em mercados como  startups, empresas de tecnologia e marcas inovadoras.
  • Experiência com metodologias de vendas como  SPIN Selling, MEDDIC, ou The Challenger Sale.
  • Conhecimento de PNL (Programação Neurolinguística) aplicada a vendas.
  • Cursos e certificações em Vendas, Inbound Marketing ou Customer Success.

Competências Importantes:

  • Comunicação, habilidade em negociação, poder de persuasão e carisma.
  • Perfil empreendedor, resiliente e orientado para resultados.
  • Capacidade de contornar objeções e lidar com frustrações.
  • Ambição voltada para o crescimento profissional e financeiro.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe, sob pressão e com metas.
  • Capacidade de dar e receber feedbacks de forma construtiva.

Informações sobre a Contratação:

  • Contrato:  PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)
  • Modelo de Trabalho:  100% Remoto (home office)

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software (Back-End) - Pleno
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software você fará parte de um dos times de desenvolvimento e será responsável por agregar conhecimento técnico ao time, sustentando, evoluindo ou construindo parte das soluções de nossa plataforma, garantindo a segurança, buscando soluções para situações do dia a dia, visando sempre o trabalho harmônico em equipe, a qualidade do código e da arquitetura em geral.

Como será o seu dia a dia no time:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, participando e fomentando práticas de Code Review e desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Participar das dinâmicas de trabalho adotadas pelo time;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa no processo de melhoria contínua do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos.
  • Trabalhar com linguagens de programação de backend como Java, Golang e NodeJS
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços
  • Trabalhar com modelo de dados hierárquico e de grafos
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões altos de performance
  • Observar o desenvolvimento seguro e estar sempre por dentro de atualizações de segurança e critérios relevantes relacionados ao desenvolvimento seguro

#Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Idealizar e construir novas soluções (análise e desenvolvimento);
  • Conceber melhorias nas arquiteturas atuais e de novas soluções;
  • Suportar questões técnicas dos projetos, em suas diversas fases, propondo soluções, indagando caminhos. Sempre de forma crítica e construtiva;
  • Recomendar modificações e melhorias em processos, visando a eficiência das áreas;
  • Solucionar/encaminhar ou ainda escalar impedimentos técnicos apontados pelo time;
  • Contribuir com o crescimento técnico do time, efetuando treinamentos, aconselhamentos (mentoria) e supervisão de pessoas desenvolvedoras menos experientes, sempre que necessário;
  • Contribuir para a produção de padrões e documentação de melhores práticas para a sua equipe e garantir que o desenvolvimento atenda a esses padrões;
  • Apoiar em práticas de desenvolvimento ágil.

#Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas para processamento de grandes volumes de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, desenvolvimento orientado a testes, escrita e documentação de códigos, code review, etc);
  • Conhecimento intermediário ou avançado em linguagem para back-end;
  • Linguagens de programação (Go, NodeJS, SQL);
  • Banco de dados relacionais, não relacionais, colunares/AVRO e elásticos (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc);
  • Estrutura Cloud (GCP);
  • Pró-eficiência no desenvolvimento de: API Rest; Programação concorrente e escalável;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento e práticas CI/CD;
  • Experiência com práticas de Code Review e Feedback;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento;
  • Promover nossa cultura e valores;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe.

Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Conhecimento dos conceitos de Big Data, Data Lake, Metadados com as perspectiva das boas práticas e requisitos de governança de dados;
  • Teoria e prática em qualidade de dados (Dimensões, Profiling, Data Quality Assessment);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Go;
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura (Terraform, Ansible);
  • Conhecimento em schedulers (Crontab, Jenkins, Airflow, etc);
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de containers (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimento em serviços de mensageria (SNS, Kafka).
  • Conhecimento de BigQuery, ElasticSearch

  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

NetEase Games is a leading global developer and publisher of video game IP across a wide variety of genres and platforms. title: Especialista em planejamento financeiro
description:
Nosso cliente é uma relevante indústria farmacêutica com forte presença no setor. O profissional será responsável por consolidar informações financeiras estratégicas de CAPEX e OPEX da planta fabril, conduzindo análises preditivas, construção de cenários e apresentações financeiras que apoiem a tomada de decisão e assegurem o alinhamento às metas corporativas.

Principais Responsabilidades e Desafios

  • Consolidar e analisar premissas financeiras, revisando gastos e custos e garantindo previsões alinhadas à rentabilidade.
  • Identificar oportunidades de otimização de recursos e maximização de resultados.
  • Atuar ativamente nos processos de S&OP, desafiando forecasts, analisando desvios e apresentando soluções para maior acuracidade.
  • Desenvolver análises de P&L, assegurando saúde financeira e viabilidade da fábrica.
  • Elaborar forecasts e análises de desvios versus PEA, fornecendo insights acionáveis para correções.
  • Produzir e consolidar apresentações financeiras robustas para PEA e Quarters, orientando a diretoria e HQ.
  • Atuar como Business Partner estratégico, questionando premissas e fornecendo recomendações para maximizar rentabilidade.
  • Apoiar processos de novos produtos, garantindo cumprimento de prazos, assertividade nas projeções e fortalecimento da cultura de planejamento financeiro.

Perfil Desejado

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia ou Ciências Contábeis; pós-graduação, MBA ou mestrado em Finanças/Controladoria.
  • +5 anos em planejamento financeiro, FP&A ou business partnering.
  • Experiência comprovada em análise e modelagem financeira.
  • Desejável vivência em indústria farmacêutica ou bens de consumo.
  • Excel avançado (incluindo macros/VBA), Power BI e conhecimento em Adaptive ou outros sistemas de planejamento financeiro.
  • Espanhol intermediário; inglês desejável.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Capacidade analítica.
  • Orientação a resultados.
  • Organização e estrutura.
  • Trabalho em equipe.
  • Proatividade.

Local de Trabalho: Pindamonhangaba / SP

Ilion Partners é uma gestora de investimentos independente, especializada na gestão ativa e no reposicionamento de ativos imobiliários em São Paulo. Atuamos em todas as fases do ciclo imobiliário, desde o retrofit até a administração estratégica dos empreendimentos.

Niilo é uma das principais plataformas de property management dedicadas a empreendimentos residenciais para locação (multifamily) no Brasil.

Envie seu currículo para com o assunto: Vaga – Atendimento Comercial.

description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

At Innodata , we partner with the world’s leading technology companies to build the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). This is a unique opportunity for writers, editors, and linguists to contribute to the forefront of AI innovation. You’ll be instrumental in teaching LLMs how to think, reason, and communicate with greater fluency and human-like nuance.

Job Title: Language Specialist – LLM Programs (Full time)

Candidates must pass our project-specific assessments (2) designed to evaluate their language proficiency and analytical abilities

title: Data Engineer
description:
Project Description:

  • The primary goal of the project is the modernization, maintenance and development of an eCommerce platform for a big US-based retail company, serving millions of omnichannel customers each week.
  • Solutions are delivered by several Product Teams focused on different domains - Customer, Loyalty, Search and Browse, Data Integration, Cart.
  • Current overriding priorities are new brands onboarding, re-architecture, database migrations, migration of microservices to a unified cloud-native solution without any disruption to business.

Responsibilities:

  • We are looking for Data Engineer who will be responsible for designing a solution for a big retail company. The main focus is to support processing of big data volumes and integrate solution to current architecture.

Mandatory Skills Description:

• Strong, recent hands-on expertise with Azure Data Factory and Synapse is a must (3+ years).

• Experience in leading a distributed team.

• Strong expertise in designing and implementing data models, including conceptual, logical, and physical data models, to support efficient data storage and retrieval.

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Databricks, pySpark for building scalable and reliable data solutions.

• Extensive experience with building robust and scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from various sources into data lakes or data warehouses.

• Ability to integrate data from disparate sources, including databases, APIs, and external data providers, using appropriate techniques such as API integration or message queuing.

• Proficiency in designing and implementing data warehousing solutions (dimensional modeling, star schemas, Data Mesh, Data/Delta Lakehouse, Data Vault)

• Proficiency in SQL to perform complex queries, data transformations, and performance tuning on cloud-based data storages.

• Experience integrating metadata and governance processes into cloud-based data platforms

• Certification in Azure, Databricks, or other relevant technologies is an added advantage

• Experience with cloud-based analytical databases.

• Experience with Azure MI, Azure Database for Postgres, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Analysis Services, and Informix.

• Experience with Python and Python-based ETL tools.

• Experience with shell scripting in Bash, Unix or windows shell is preferable.

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• Experience with Elasticsearch

• Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Troubleshooting and Performance Tuning: Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in data processing workflows and optimize data pipelines for efficient data ingestion and analysis.

• Collaboration and Communication: Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with stakeholders, data engineers, data scientists, and other cross-functional teams.

Languages:

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Procurement Manager
description:
Business Introduction

JD Industrials, a subsidiary of JD Group, focuses on industrial supply chain technologies and services, with a market capitalization of approximately $5 billion.

Our business is to support the development of enterprises from the industrial manufacturing industry through the integrated model of "supply chain + technology + service", and create a B to B procurement platform for industrial products. We provide industrial procurement solutions to more than 7,000 large customers and more than 8 million small and medium-sized business customers. We work with more than 30,000 suppliers of industrial goods, and our platform has more than 40 million SKUs .

Now JD Industrials focuses on developing overseas business, providing one-stop industrial product procurement solutions for enterprises from different countries. Our business has spread to Southeast Asia, Europe, the Middle East and South America .

Role Overview

We are looking for a category procurement specialist who will be responsible for driving fulfillment and gross margin.

Location: R. do Paraíso, 595 - 11o Andar - Paraíso, São Paulo - SP ,

Job Description

  1. Responsible for undertaking the construction and sourcing of the national supply chain, and responsible for the satisfaction rate of goods.
  2. Responsible for the recruitment, maintenance, management and elimination of suppliers in the country to which they belong, and improve the width of customer demand satisfaction.
  3. Implement national category planning, continuously optimize costs, and enhance price competitiveness.
  4. According to customer needs, implement the stocking plan, and be responsible for the stocking turnover.

Qualifications

  1. Have more than 3 years of working experience in the industrial products industry or related fields, have a full understanding of the industrial products market structure, and be familiar with industry trends and market dynamics.
  2. Excellent communication and negotiation skills, able to establish good relationships with suppliers.
  3. Excellent cross-departmental communication and collaboration skills.
  4. Have good professional ethics and conduct, passionate, creative, work under pressure, and be willing to accept challenges.
  5. Sensitive to data and able to conduct effective data analysis and decision-making.

title: Analista tributário sênior
description:
We Are PepsiCo

Join PepsiCo and Dare for Better! We are the perfect place for curious people, thinkers and change agents. From leadership to front lines, we're excited about the future and working together to make the world a better place.

Being part of PepsiCo means being part of one of the largest food and beverage companies in the world, with our iconic brands consumed more than a billion times a day in more than 200 countries.

PepsiCo Brasil: In Brazil since 1953, PepsiCo has well-known brands such as QUAKER®, TODDY®, TODDYNHO®, ELMA CHIPS®, RUFFLES®, DORITOS®, EQLIBRI™, GATORADE®, KERO COCO®, H2OH!®, PEPSI®, among others.

A career at PepsiCo means working in a culture where all people are welcome. Here, you can dare to be you. No matter who you are, where you're from, or who you love, you can always influence the people around you and make a positive impact in the world.

Know more: PepsiCoJobs

Join PepsiCo, dare for better.

The Opportunity

Serve as a technical reference in the tax area, focusing on compliance, tax planning, and strategic support to leadership. Ensure adherence to current legislation while identifying opportunities for tax efficiency.

Your Impact

This position is responsible for strategic tax planning analyses across all Brazilian legal entities within the group (PdB, PBI, PABB, Pepsicola), with a focus on anticipating tax impacts, identifying efficiency opportunities, and ensuring full compliance with applicable legislation.

1. Respond to tax-related inquiries from business areas, providing clear and accurate guidance aligned with current legislation.

2. Define and communicate tax rules applicable to all new company operations, ensuring proper implementation and compliance.

3. Periodically review and update existing tax rules used across the organization to reflect legislative changes and business needs.

4. Support the tax manager in delivering training sessions to business teams, aiming to raise awareness and mitigate tax-related risks.

5. Collaborate with the tax legal team on strategic analyses and technical assessments to identify opportunities for tax efficiency and risk reduction.

6. Provide tax support for innovation projects under evaluation by the Marketing team, including taxation analysis for new products.

7. Assist in the review of commercial and operational contracts from a tax perspective.

8. Maintain updated reports and dashboards for the tax manager, ensuring visibility of key metrics and ongoing initiatives.

9. Act as a key partner to the business in the implementation of the Brazilian tax reform, supporting impact assessments, process adjustments, and the transition to the new tax framework

Who Are We Looking For?

  • Solid understanding of tax legislation; Understanding of tax accounting, including bookkeeping, calculation of taxes and contributions and development of tax returns.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law (with OAB) or Accounting (with CRC). A degree in Business Administration with an MBA in Tax Management is also acceptable.
  • Experience in the tax area, with a background in compliance, planning, and strategic projects.
  • Solid knowledge of federal and state taxes, ancillary obligations, tax law, direct taxes, and corporate tax.
  • Intermediate to advanced English.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel; experience with SAP and Mastersaf is a plus.
  • Good negotiation and communication skills (oral and written). Proactiveness. Resilience. Strategic thinking.

If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.

What can you expect from us:

• Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs.

• Internal digital platforms that promote self-learning.

• Development programs according to Leadership skills.

• Specialized training according to the role.

• Learning experiences with internal and external providers.

• We love to celebrate success, which is why we have recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life, among others.

• Financial wellness programs that will help you reach your goals in all stages of life.

• A flexibility program that will allow you to balance your personal and work life, adapting your working day to your lifestyle.

• And because your family is also important to us, they can also enjoy benefits such as our Wellness Line, thousands of Agreements and Discounts, Scholarship programs for your children, Aid Plans for different moments of life, among others.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We respect and value diversity as a work force and innovation for the organization.

Alcançar KPIs e performance da loja otimizando os recursos operacionais para oferecer aos consumidores uma experiência memorável, buscando obter sua fidelidade. Desenvolver a equipe, mantê-la motivada e utilizar todas as ferramentas disponíveis para alcançar performance comercial.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Impulsionar o gerenciamento de vendas, de pessoal e das operações, para executar a meta da loja e atingir os objetivos da empresa, proporcionando uma experiência memorável ao consumidor de forma a garantir o cumprimento dos padrões de atendimento da adidas.
  • Colaborar com o District Manager ou outros parceiros de Retail Back Office a fim de aprimorar continuamente a loja diante de desafios, identificar melhores práticas e se manter atualizado sobre nossos concorrentes para aprimorar a performance da empresa.
  • Responsabilizar-se pelos KPIs da loja, garantir que a equipe tenha ciência deles e da forma como contribuem através da análise de dados relevantes e tomar decisões comerciais para aprimorá-los.
  • Estimular a conformidade de todos os processos e procedimentos e garantir a compreensão e observância da equipe, a fim de assegurar os padrões da adidas e reduzir riscos, mantendo um ambiente de trabalho e compras seguro e produtivo.

  • Liderar, motivar, inspirar e desenvolver os membros da equipe e gerenciar todos os procedimentos de pessoal para garantir o engajamento dos funcionários, a produtividade e uma cultura de alta performance, definindo expectativas claras, dando feedback adequado e imediato, e liderando pelo exemplo enquanto defensor da Marca, demonstrando consistentemente os 3 Cs (Confiança, Colaboração e Criatividade) para reforçar a cultura da adidas.
  • Concluir todos os programas de treinamento aplicáveis, colocar o aprendizado em prática com eficácia e garantir que todos os membros da equipe da loja estejam capacitados em Foundational e Seasonal Brand e tenham conhecimento sobre o produto.
  • Treinar a equipe para que esteja totalmente atualizada, compreender as ferramentas digitais e responder pelo atendimento de pós-venda, para a implementação correta na loja, promovendo a experiência de compra e venda omnicanal.
  • Trabalhar sempre priorizando a equipe, em total respeito com todos os colegas e contribuindo ativamente para tornar seu local de trabalho um ambiente inclusivo e acolhedor para todos.

Principais Relações

  • Consumidores
  • Equipe de apoio do back office
  • Fornecedores
  • Administração local (shopping centers)

  • Total domínio de todas as ferramentas e processos operacionais da loja, do funcionamento da loja e de como atingir os KPIs.
  • Compreensão dos padrões de Visual Merchandising para impulsionar a conversão através de ações estratégicas.
  • Conectar, engajar e inspirar ativamente os consumidores.
  • Comunicar um desejo de aprendizado contínuo e acolher todas as oportunidades disponíveis para aumentar as performances própria e da loja através da compreensão do ambiente de retail, dos produtos, do conhecimento da marca e do comportamento do consumidor.
  • Comunicação verbal e escrita eficaz e fluente. Capacidade de transmitir informações a outras pessoas. Lidar com conversas difíceis de forma construtiva e utilizar habilidades comunicacionais para viabilizar uma ótima experiência para o consumidor.
  • Capacidade de demonstrar agilidade e responsividade ao liderar e implementar processos e estratégias, incluindo ofertas omnicanais e soluções digitais.
  • Capacidade de lidar com diferentes situações de loja e gerenciá-las de forma a encontrar uma solução.
  • Ser capaz de atrair, reter e engajar pessoal para que este tenha a melhor performance possível, fazendo uso de ferramentas de coaching, reconhecimento e desenvolvimento, promovendo um ambiente de equipe diversificado e inclusivo.

  • Sólida experiência no gerenciamento de dados, métricas e KPIs de operações de retail.

A Hyundai Motor Company , sediada na Coreia do Sul, está passando por uma transição significativa de ser fabricante de automóveis para se tornar provedora de soluções de mobilidade inteligente. Para acelerar a concretização dessa mudança, estamos investindo em tecnologias inovadoras que transformarão a maneira como as pessoas interagem com suas soluções de mobilidade e melhorarão sua qualidade de vida.

Comprometida com a sustentabilidade, a Hyundai iniciou medidas para liderar uma era de mobilidade mais sustentável eletrificando sua linha de produtos e expandindo seus negócios de hidrogênio para veículos comerciais e dispositivos de utilidade. Além da mobilidade, confiaremos na economia circular para moldar um futuro mais sustentável que beneficiará não apenas a Hyundai como empresa, mas a sociedade como um todo.

A Hyundai Motor Brasil começou suas operações em 2012, introduzindo o modelo único HB20 no mercado local, projetado e desenvolvido especificamente para o país. Atualmente, a empresa atua como sede regional para a América Central e do Sul, exportando do Brasil para Uruguai, Paraguai, Colômbia e México. Com perspectivas promissoras para a região, a Hyundai Motor Brasil, também conhecida como Hyundai Motor Central & South América, está introduzindo tecnologia de ponta de modelos premiados mundialmente, como o IONIQ 5, e avançando para implementar soluções movidas a hidrogênio junto com ações sociais e ambientais para contribuir com as sociedades onde opera na região. Se você aspira fazer parte de uma equipe líder em inovação na indústria automotiva, venha se juntar a nós na Hyundai e faça parte desta jornada rumo ao sucesso.

Movimento audacioso, energia positiva e trabalho de qualidade; este é o nosso DNA Hyundai; este foi o poder que nos permitiu ser líder global na indústria automotiva e será o poder para criar um novo mundo. title: Desenvolvedor Jr ML Development (P&D)
description:
We’re looking for a professional to join our team in São Paulo .

Location: São Paulo – Hybrid (up to 2x per week on-site, if needed)

Contract: PJ (Independent Contractor)

Compensation: Competitive fee aligned with current market standards

If you’re interested or know someone who might be a great fit, please get in touch!

The ideal candidate will be responsible for conceptualizing and executing clear, quality code to develop the best software. You will test your code, identify errors, and iterate to ensure quality code. You will also support our customers and partners by troubleshooting any of their software issues. 

ML Programming & Frameworks:

Basic understanding of Python and its use in data science.

Familiarity with core ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, and Scikit-learn.

Basic knowledge of deep learning frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.

Understanding of fundamental machine learning concepts (e.g., supervised vs. unsupervised learning, regression, classification).

Large Language Models (LLMs) & Generative AI:

Basic understanding of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture, including concepts like retrievers, vector databases, and how external knowledge is used to augment LLM prompts.

Familiarity with the basic concepts of fine-tuning LLMs for specific tasks or domains (e.g., understanding that it involves further training a pre-trained model on a smaller, specialized dataset).

Databases & Data Management:

Fundamental understanding of relational databases like PostgreSQL or MySQL for data storage.

Basic knowledge of NoSQL databases like MongoDB.

Ability to write simple database queries to extract data for ML models.

Familiarity with data manipulation and cleaning techniques.

Architecture & Infrastructure:

Basic understanding of how ML models are integrated into applications.

Awareness of basic data pipelines and model deployment concepts.

Development Tools & Processes:

Proficiency with Git for version control (cloning, committing, pushing, pulling).

Understanding of collaborative workflows (e.g., pull requests).

Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) for ML model deployment is a plus.

Testing & Debugging:

Basic understanding of the importance of model evaluation and testing (e.g., metrics like accuracy, precision, recall).

Ability to use debugging tools to identify and fix simple issues in ML code.

Nice to Have

DevOps & Cloud:

Curiosity about deployment processes for ML models and cloud platforms, specifically services for generative AI like AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI (especially its generative AI features), or Azure OpenAI Service / Azure Machine Learning Studio.

Basic understanding of Docker for containerizing ML applications.

Security Best Practices:

Awareness of data privacy and security considerations in ML.

Any personal ML projects, Kaggle participation, or contributions to open-source ML initiatives.

Required Behavioral Skills

Collaboration & Communication:

Willingness to work effectively within a team.

Ability to clearly articulate thoughts and ask questions, especially regarding data and model insights.

Problem Solving & Initiative:

Eagerness to learn and tackle new challenges in machine learning.

Proactive in seeking solutions and asking for help when needed.

Adaptability & Continuous Learning:

Strong desire to learn new ML technologies, algorithms, and research.

Openness to feedback and continuous improvement.

Language Requirements

  • Language: Good spoken and written English is required.

title: Subject Matter Expert-Technical Support
description:
Role: Technical Support Subject Matter Expert-Trilingual in Portuguese+Spanish+English

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Salary: BRL 3300/month

Primary Work Environment

This position will be a resource for level 1 and level 2 support analysts to resolve problems requiring a greater level of technical expertise and/or time. Level 3 support analysts can expect to spend most of their time researching and resolving technical problems/issues and may be required to work as primary Level 1/2 staff if shorthanded. Technical information training and dissemination to global service desk staff is key for this role. Responsibility for creating, updating, and reviewing Solutions Center owned knowledge base documents is a normal daily activity. There may be large/small project involvement when Solutions Center resources are needed, or information needs to be disseminated to Solutions Center staff globally. This position will require frequent interaction between Solutions Center staff, other IT groups, and management. Travel to other sites to address end user issues may be required.

Responsibilities

  1. Internal service desk escalator for issues requiring more extensive troubleshooting, investigation, or time for resolution.
  2. Advanced end user technical resolution on items such as PC hardware and software issues; software installations and upgrades.
  3. Provide advanced support duties for applications, network, server, and security functions where interaction is required with the appropriate IT functional teams all in support of addressing end user issues. This generally coincides with advanced privileges in various areas.
  4. Support for labs, special builds, VIPs, and emergency support on a scheduled or ad hoc basis; often at the request of the Solutions Center Manager / Team Lead (as needed).
  5. Population and maintenance of Solutions Center owned knowledge base documents.
  6. Proactive recognition and resolution of end user and IT support issues to maintain a high level of visibility within the end user community.
  7. Participate in projects and incident reviews that will enhance the quality of the Solutions Center service level and promote technical and career growth.
  8. Participate in interview process for level 1 and 2 support analysts in region (where applicable).
  9. Train all new regional Solutions Center and support staff.
  10. Coach, mentor and educate level 1 and level 2 support analysts on critical thinking, end user experience and technical skills to solve end user issues.
  11. Perform data center support tasks supporting follow the sun model (where applicable).
  12. Fill in for primary level 1 and 2 solutions center tasks when needed based on volume, staffing or emergency.
  13. Attend global team meetings when needed (may be off hours).
  14. Perform Major Incident Escalation Coordinator activities to ensure a timely and efficient resolution of incidents that are impacting the business (may be off hours).

Recommended Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have a four-year technical degree and/or 3-6 years of related experience and will possess the following skills and abilities:

  1. Excellent communication skills including active listening skills and ability to convey empathy.
  2. Customer service skills with the ability to provide consistent, positive end user experiences and address issues proactively.
  3. Analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to use all available resources to resolve or anticipate problems, in turn creating or updating processes, procedures, and resolutions in the knowledgebase as needed.
  4. Time management skills including setting appropriate expectations with end users for resolution.
  5. Ability to be a team player, offering and accepting feedback and sharing knowledge with others, while being able to work independently and require minimal supervision.
  6. Relationship-building skills including the ability to develop intra- and inter-team relationship as well as build and establish rapport with end users efficiently.
  7. Multi-tasking abilities while focusing on effective prioritization of work.
  8. Identify and seek out opportunities for continuous improvement.
  9. Independent worker with the ability to define and share work plans, communicate on a timely and appropriate basis, all while requiring minimal supervision.

The ideal candidate will also have knowledge in, and familiarity with, the following:

  1. Microsoft Windows 10 / 11
  2. Office 365 applications including Teams, OneDrive, Outlook, and OneNote
  3. Microsoft Internet Explorer and Edge, Google Chrome, and Safari
  4. Adobe Acrobat, Foxit Reader, or other PDF applications
  5. ServiceNow
  6. VMware Horizon View
  7. Palo Alto Global Protect (VPN)
  8. iOS/Android devices
  9. System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM)
  10. Windows Internals
  11. Networking Fundamentals
  12. Information Security Fundamentals
  13. Server Fundamentals
  14. SAP

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

#

Oportunidade para Analista de Dados Especialista!

Atividades que o profissional irá exercer:

  • Coletar e interpretar dados do estado bruto para insights.

title: Project Analyst (Mining/Minerals/Metals)
description:
Project Analyst (Mining)

Curitiba/PR, Brazil

Position type: Full-Time, in-person

Reports to: Regional Director, IPA-LA

Date posted: August 22, 2025

Closing date: Open until filled

Introduction

Are you passionate about what makes complex capital projects really tick—are you curious how the business and project worlds combine to deliver future assets? Do you love making connections and solving puzzles or problems? Are you detailed and focused, yet you also have broad interests and ideas and excellent communication skills? Do you enjoy analytical research work while also being comfortable client-facing?

If so, please apply as a Project Analyst – Mining/Minerals/Metals Sector in IPA’s Latin America office! The Project Analyst will lead evaluations and consulting for major Mining/Minerals/Metals players to help them improve the effectiveness of their capital projects.

About the Role

Independent Project Analysis (IPA) has an opening position in our Latin America office (located in Curitiba/PR, Brazil) for a Project Analyst – Mining/Minerals/Metals Sector. The candidate should have a proven track record working on capital projects or analyzing project feasibility in the mining, minerals, or metals sectors. Candidates are required to have strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to contribute as a thought leader. Aptitude for and demonstrated skills to be a successful analyst include your ability to connect in real life with the data and vice versa, to know when to ask more questions and when to just listen, as well as to be self-motivated to learn and thrive.

IPA’s client portfolio includes world-leading companies in both the heavy and light industries around the world. IPA has offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, The Netherlands, Australia, Brazil, and Singapore; as such, major industry leaders globally rely on us to assess the health of their capital project systems and provide recommendations to improve their performance. IPA evaluates hundreds of capital projects every year, developing very complete technical, business, and people histories from their front-end through early operation. These histories become the data we use to find what works and what does not work in capital projects. The IPA project databases are unique and the most comprehensive sources of capital project experience in existence. IPA also takes a leading role in empirical research into the drivers of better projects and project systems, using our extensive databases of past project performance.

Responsibilities

General responsibilities of the role include:

  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations from the major Mining/Minerals/Metals sector companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Interfacing with clients to collect and analyse technical, cost, schedule, and project management data
  • Writing reports with insight and a customer focus
  • Delivering verbal feedback and public presentations
  • Conducting research on the drivers of project success or failure using proprietary databases and statistics

Day in the Life

Responsibilities of the Project Analyst – Mining/Minerals/Metals Sector role include:

  • Interfacing directly with clients in-person to collect project data and uncover areas of risk
  • Applying statistical analysis to quantify your findings
  • Writing reports to provide insight and recommendations for clients
  • Delivering verbal feedback and presentations to technical and business audiences
  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Conducting research on the drivers of project success and failure using IPA’s proprietary databases and statistics

Skills and Qualities

Project Analyst – Mining/Mineral/Metals Sector must have:

  • Demonstrable Portuguese and English language oral and written communication skills; fluency in Spanish is an advantage
  • Solid analytical skills
  • Ability to demonstrate intellectual curiosity and organizational leadership
  • Excellent listening, presentation, and report writing skills with strong attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal skills to develop and maintain relationships at senior levels with client companies and liaise with people from other cultures
  • Strong work ethic
  • High self-motivation and ability to work independently
  • Positive attitude and willingness to work in a team
  • Ability to work to tight deadlines and under pressure
  • Flexibility in taking on a variety of assignments

Travel

  • This position requires travel up to 30% of each month; candidates are required to have proper documentation for necessary business travel
  • Travel will be required primarily within Latin America and is primarily on weekdays

Education and Experience

  • A Master’s degree (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent in mining engineering, geology, or allied fields are required
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience with mining, minerals, or metals companies
  • Proven record of carrying out independent research or using a variety of statistical methods to analyze large amounts of data

WHY IPA?

For over 35 years, IPA has delivered groundbreaking research and quantitative risk analyses to enhance the value generated by our clients’ capital project systems and meet their obligations for sustainable and safe performance. IPA guides capital‑intensive organizations to establish the right combination of people, work process, and governance to maximize performance across several measures: cost, schedule, safety, operability performance, and carbon reduction. We have a dataset of over 24,000 capital projects as the basis of our work. Our clients are leading companies in the energy, minerals, infrastructure, chemicals, pharmaceutical, and consumer products sectors. IPA is committed to social and ethical responsibility, and all global offices initiate or participate in local charity initiatives to support those in need .

HOW TO APPLY

Applicants should complete the form at and include a cover letter, resume, and salary requirement.

title: District commercial manager
description:
1. About us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage!

2. Responsibilities

  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist Keeta in establishing a food delivery sales team in new cities, starting from scratch to drive business expansion. Through systematic one-on-one or group training and empowerment models, rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals.
  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth communication channels within and outside the team. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building : Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment : Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking : Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.

3. Basic Requirements

  • Management Experience : Has experience in managing sales teams, with outstanding performance in another company over the past year.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing : Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking : Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development : Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English and Portuguese (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work and travel.

4. Job Highlights

Join us to witness the rapid growth of Meituan's global food delivery business and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: Apaixonados por Mercado Financeiro - Porto Alegre/RS
description:

title: Cientista de Dados
description:
A Agromai é uma empresa inovadora no setor agrícola, dedicada a conectar produtores rurais com soluções tecnológicas sustentáveis. Estamos expandindo nossa equipe de Ciência de Dados para impulsionar análises avançadas que otimizem processos agrícolas por meio de dados geográficos e espaciais. Junte-se a nós para resolver desafios reais no agronegócio!

Descrição da Vaga:

Buscamos um profissional com formação em Física, Matemática ou áreas afins, ou com comprovada capacidade analítica, para integrar nosso time de Ciência de Dados. Essa posição envolve o uso de bibliotecas especializadas para manipular e analisar dados complexos, contribuindo para inovações no setor agro.

Responsabilidades Principais:

Desenvolver e implementar arquiteturas em Python e Django para sistemas de análise espacial.

Processar e analisar dados geográficos com ferramentas como PostGIS, integrando bibliotecas como Pandas, GeoPandas, Geocoder, Rasterio, Redis, GDAL e NumPy.

Aplicar métodos analíticos para resolver problemas reais, como otimização de rotas agrícolas, mapeamento de solos ou previsão de colheitas baseadas em dados espaciais.

Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para integrar soluções de dados em fluxos de trabalho operacionais.

Realizar testes, depuração e otimização de códigos para garantir eficiência e escalabilidade.

Gerar relatórios e visualizações de dados para suportar decisões estratégicas na Agromai.

Requisitos:

Formação superior em Física, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas (ou equivalente em experiência prática com forte capacidade analítica).

Experiência comprovada - 5 anos como cientista de dados

Conhecimento em processamento de dados geográficos e bibliotecas como Pandas, GeoPandas, Rasterio e NumPy.

Experiência ou interesse demonstrado na aplicação de métodos analíticos para resolver problemas reais, preferencialmente no setor agro ou áreas afins.

Habilidades em análise de dados, resolução de problemas e trabalho em equipe.

Excelente comunicação em português (inglês técnico é um diferencial).

Disponibilidade para trabalho presencial.

Diferenciais:

Experiência em machine learning aplicado a dados espaciais (ex: com Scikit-learn ou TensorFlow).

Conhecimento em cloud computing (GCP) para processamento de grandes volumes de dados.

Portfólio de projetos envolvendo análise espacial ou geoprocessamento.

O Que Oferecemos:

Benefícios como plano de saúde, vale-refeição, oportunidades de capacitação e crescimento profissional.

Ambiente colaborativo e inovador no coração do agronegócio.

  • Chance de impactar diretamente soluções sustentáveis para o setor agropecuário
